text: That’s Motostoke, way off that way![VAR 0114(0005)]
And between there and here are countless new\nPokémon waiting to be met![VAR 0114(0005)]
Oh, hello.\nAnd if it isn’t Sonia.[VAR 0114(0005)]

My gran gave me a proper earful, in her
own way...\c
“Those two young Trainers are setting out on
a journey, but what are you doing with your life?”[VAR 0114(000B)]

Ah... Never you mind that!
Nothing to worry yourselves over!\c
Besides, I’d been quite curious about that
Pokémon you two met in the forest.\c
I’d been thinking I should look into it, so
the timing works out fine![VAR 0114(000B)]
If I discover something really huge, then maybe\neven Gran’ll admit I’ve got some talent![VAR 0114(000B)]
Yikes...\nBeing an adult has got its own challenges, eh?[VAR 0114(0005)]

I said you needn’t worry about it!\c
I’m glad to be on the road. Really! It’s been ages.\c
It’ll be great fun to fish and camp and
rough it outside again.[VAR 0114(000B)]

Well, I’m off to go stick my head in as many of
those red glowing dens as I can find.\c
I’m going to battle the snot out of a bunch of
Dynamax Pokémon and fill in another page
in the tale of my legend![VAR 0114(0005)]

What cheek! Dynamax Pokémon are
really on another level, you know!\c
You’d better Dynamax your partner Pokémon,
too, if you want to take on opponents that strong![VAR 0114(000B)]

You’ll find spots here and there in the Wild Area
that emit a red beam of light.\c
If you think you’re up to it, check them out.
There’ll be Dynamax Pokémon lurking inside!\c
So with that, how about I send you off with a
little treat from me?[VAR 0114(000B)]

With a Pokémon Box Link, you’ll be able to
put Pokémon from your team into your Boxes
or take Pokémon from your Boxes to add them
to your team. Nice, right?\c
So go wild catching as many Pokémon as you
like, and fill in some more of your Pokédex![VAR 0114(000B)]
The Wild Area is waiting for you!\nThis is the start of your real adventure![VAR 0114(000B)]
